Iris: Spawning follow-up: what about the memory optimization that strips tombstone payloads but keeps a compact marker? We currently remove tombstone objects entirely.
Noah: The compact marker could be a 16-byte record: prefix-hash + deleted-epoch. Much smaller. Also can be bloom-aggregated.
Ravi: How does this interact with prefix compaction? If compaction rewrites keyspace without tombstones, markers must be updated.
julie: Suggest marker lifecycle: created on delete, propagated via epoch stream, aged out after window W or explicit ack. Compactor must copy marker when it rewrites segments.
Iris: Edgecases: migration where older nodes don't understand markers. Need compatibility flags and fallbacks.
Noah: We should provide a compatibility handshake during rolling deploys: node announces tombstone-marker-capability. Older nodes continue to emit full tombstones until all are upgraded.
Ravi: Tests: compatibility rolling upgrade simulation, ensure no stale-read regression during mixed-version cluster.
kv-bot: ci: run marker-compat smoke suite 3/3 jobs passing.
Iris: ok I'll fold this into the RFC with marker schema and migration plan.
